_comment: Reference mcp.json for the drillr MCP server. Drop the `mcpServers.drillr` block into your host's mcp.json and replace <YOUR_DRILLR_API_KEY> (including angle brackets) with your drl_* key from https://drillr.ai/developer/keys. Power users on env-var-aware hosts (Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code) can keep ${DRILLR_API_KEY} instead and export it in the shell.
